foodOcclusionPolicy.representation: One native editable camera-facing packed2D billboard; body and knife remain native3D. The food stays in its original declared state visibility schedule.

orientationDefinition.forward: F = normalize(horizontal(groundRootWorldRotation * nativeForward)); nativeForward is the fixed source character-forward axis (0,-1,0) in the existing ground-root frame. Retain intrinsic child orientation. Use the ground root, not animated head/hand normals or a state-dependent vector.
orientationDefinition.towardCamera: H = normalize(horizontal(camera.matrix_world.to_3x3() * (0,0,1))), the orthographic toward-camera axis. Do not use camera location minus character location. The fixed registered capture has H=(0,-1,0).
orientationDefinition.f: f = clamp(dot(F,H),-1,1). At the unchanged publisher orientations S0/E+90/N180/W-90, f is respectively +1/0/-1/0. In this exact source/camera contract the algebraically equivalent f=cos(rootYaw) is allowed; it must remain the same continuous law at all angles.

foodOcclusionPolicy.law: d(f) = 0.60 - 0.15 * max(0,-f)^2 world cells; no tunable coefficients or alternative piecewise per-view constants in this version.
foodOcclusionPolicy.continuity: C1 on [-1,1]: for f<0, d=0.60-0.15*f^2 and derivative=-0.30*f; for f>=0, d=0.60 and derivative=0. Both derivatives meet at zero. Composed with the continuous native root/camera orientation, the displacement has no orientation threshold jump. Natural geometry occlusion boundaries still require visual evaluation.
foodOcclusionPolicy.worldOffset: Let A be the unchanged evaluated food-root/plate-bottom attachment origin, and R=normalize(camera.matrix_world.to_3x3()*(0,0,1)). The billboard origin is A+d(f)*R, using the same original ray sign. In the registered camera R=(0,-cos(35deg),sin(35deg)). Derive the native plane local XYZ location through its unchanged parent transform, all from the same d. Preserve the plane rotation, yaw cancellation, mesh and fullUV. Do not independently tune Z or an XY coefficient.
foodOcclusionPolicy.permittedNativeImplementation: Native Blender driver expressions/variables or an equivalent fully saved native editable dependency graph implementing this fixed law. It must reopen and evaluate without an external driver namespace, startup handler or undeclared script. A source-expression audit and numerical evaluation must demonstrate the same law between the four output facings.
forbiddenInputsAndMethods: No state name, frame index, atlas cell, publisher-facing label, discrete orientation lookup, custom angle mask, hysteresis or per-pose fitted parameter.
No object visibility/holdout/shadow/material/alpha policy changes, per-view hiding or pixel masks.
No screen-space relocation, target fit, source crop/repaint/regrade/warp, altered plane shape/aspect/width, body patch or new occluder.
foodOcclusionPolicy.physicalScope: Only the billboard display offset changes along the exact orthographic ray. Original food-root, plate-bottom palm contact, rig, actions, authored bob, body/knife envelopes and functional clearance remain exact; the offset billboard is excluded from the native physical body footprint.

pixelEqualityNote: Idle/work: 96/96 exactly equal round01; 0 changed pixels, maximum channel error 0, 0 alpha differences. Held/load S/E/W are compared with round01(.60); N with round02(.45). All96 held/load comparisons: 46/96 exact. Every frame difference is quantified by changed-pixel/component counts, error histograms, alpha/opaque/composited maxima; individual changed pixels are also listed when fewer20. No raster substitution or patching. The saved-source semantic/projection audit independently constrains all non-occlusion data. Maximum held/load alpha-channel error 8; opaqueRGB error 8; compositedRGB error 8 across light/gray/dark. Native source semantics and all192 screen registration pass; closed replay is exact.
